{"type":"thought","data":"Carefully analyzing "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the market and prior"}
{"type":"thought","data":" results."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe match has not "}
{"type":"thought","data":"yet started. Iğdır FK"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is tied with Bursaspor"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on 19 points and Kayserispor"}
{"type":"thought","data":" leads with 22. Keçiörengücü"}
{"type":"thought","data":" has 16 points but a"}
{"type":"thought","data":" better goal difference"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and more goals scored."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nKeçiörengücü's recent"}
{"type":"thought","data":" form is mixed. They"}
{"type":"thought","data":" won at Bodrum and home"}
{"type":"thought","data":" against Sarıyer but"}
{"type":"thought","data":" drew at Sivasspor and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Vanspor. Iğdır FK has"}
{"type":"thought","data":" been dominant with "}
{"type":"thought","data":"six wins in nine games."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nKeçiörengücü is unbeaten"}
{"type":"thought","data":" in their last five "}
{"type":"thought","data":"matches. Iğdır FK has"}
{"type":"thought","data":" been winning at a higher"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rate in recent fixtures."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nBookmaker odds imply"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a home win probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" near 47 percent. That"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is slightly below the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market price of 0.435."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The implied fair probabilities"}
{"type":"thought","data":" from Turkish iddaa "}
{"type":"thought","data":"and Sportbet both suggest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the home team is overpriced."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nFlashscore, Bookmaker.eu,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and Superpronostici"}
{"type":"thought","data":" all imply a home win"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability near 48"}
{"type":"thought","data":" percent. Oddalerts "}
{"type":"thought","data":"and Footywow estimate"}
{"type":"thought","data":" it closer to 45 percent."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The market price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.435 sits slightly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" below these fair estimates."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe edge is small."}
{"type":"thought","data":" I am checking how the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bench market pays out"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to see if a 100-token"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet on Yes is worthwhile."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe payout structure"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is now clear. A winning"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet returns 100 divided"}
{"type":"thought","data":" by the price paid, "}
{"type":"thought","data":"so profit equals 100"}
{"type":"thought","data":" times (p/c - 1). Expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value is therefore "}
{"type":"thought","data":"100 times (p/c - 1),"}
{"type":"thought","data":" where p is the true"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability and c is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the market price."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nExpected value calculations"}
{"type":"thought","data":" confirm the edge. Buying"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Yes at 0.435 yields"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly +8 tokens if"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the true probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is 47 percent, and "}
{"type":"thought","data":"+3 to +5 tokens for "}
{"type":"thought","data":"lower estimates. Buying"}
{"type":"thought","data":" No at 0.565 produces"}
{"type":"thought","data":" losses of about -2 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"to -6 tokens across "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the same range. The "}
{"type":"thought","data":"positive expected value"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on Yes makes it the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" clear choice."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe Turkish iddaa "}
{"type":"thought","data":"odds are the local sharp"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market, though heavily"}
{"type":"thought","data":" margin-adjusted. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market price sits slightly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" below the bookmaker"}
{"type":"thought","data":" consensus. The edge"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is modest at roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" three to five percentage"}
{"type":"thought","data":" points. The lower price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" may reflect lag or "}
{"type":"thought","data":"stale data from the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"bookmakers."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe home price has"}
{"type":"thought","data":" tightened slightly "}
{"type":"thought","data":"from +108 to +103. Iğdır's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" recent form is inconsistent"}
{"type":"thought","data":" across sources, though"}
{"type":"thought","data":" they remain the stronger"}
{"type":"thought","data":" team by table position"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and recent results."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe head-to-head record"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is even at two wins"}
{"type":"thought","data":" apiece with no draws."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Keçiörengücü lost their"}
{"type":"thought","data":" last home meeting against"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Iğdır. A draw would"}
{"type":"thought","data":" resolve to No, so the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" home win is the only"}
{"type":"thought","data":" winning outcome."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI have a history of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" underestimating draws."}
{"type":"thought","data":" I lost several draw"}
{"type":"thought","data":" markets by picking "}
{"type":"thought","data":"No when the match ended"}
{"type":"thought","data":" in a draw. I also lost"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on favorite picks that"}
{"type":"thought","data":" did not win. This pattern"}
{"type":"thought","data":" makes me cautious about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" betting Yes here."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe exact math confirms"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the edge. A 100-token"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet on Yes at 0.435"}
{"type":"thought","data":" yields a profit of "}
{"type":"thought","data":"roughly 129.9 tokens"}
{"type":"thought","data":" if Keçiörengücü wins,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" but costs 100 tokens"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to lose. At a true "}
{"type":"thought","data":"probability of 47 percent,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expected value is about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" +8.05 tokens. Betting"}
{"type":"thought","data":" No at 0.565 would return"}
{"type":"thought","data":" only about 77 tokens"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on a win, making it"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a clear negative expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value.\n\nThe Kelly criterion"}
{"type":"thought","data":" does not apply because"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the stake is fixed "}
{"type":"thought","data":"at 100 tokens. The goal"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is to maximize expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" profit, not simply "}
{"type":"thought","data":"pick the most likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" outcome. I am now weighing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" what other agents will"}
{"type":"thought","data":" do and how to optimize"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expected P&L."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe phrase \"most likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pay off\" is ambiguous."}
{"type":"thought","data":" It could mean the outcome"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with the highest probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of winning, or the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"bet with the best expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value. Because this"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is a single round and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the goal is to win "}
{"type":"thought","data":"against three other "}
{"type":"thought","data":"agents, the latter interpretation"}
{"type":"thought","data":" matters more. Expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value maximizes profit"}
{"type":"thought","data":" across the competition,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" not just the most probable"}
{"type":"thought","data":" result."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI cannot predict the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" other agents' picks."}
{"type":"thought","data":" If they all favor No,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" I will win by choosing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Yes. Variance is a "}
{"type":"thought","data":"key concern because "}
{"type":"thought","data":"expected value does "}
{"type":"thought","data":"not guarantee the best"}
{"type":"thought","data":" score."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe expected value"}
{"type":"thought","data":" gap is too large to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" ignore. I will set "}
{"type":"thought","data":"my confidence to the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" true probability estimate"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rather than the market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe confidence flag"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is `--confidence <0-1>`."}
{"type":"thought","data":" I will check the bet"}
{"type":"thought","data":" help to confirm how"}
{"type":"thought","data":" it works. Only a few"}
{"type":"thought","data":" minutes remain before"}
{"type":"thought","data":" kickoff and the market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" closes. I will place"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the bet now rather "}
{"type":"thought","data":"than research further."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe Turkish iddaa "}
{"type":"thought","data":"MS1 price of 1.78 implies"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a home win probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" near 46.5 percent, "}
{"type":"thought","data":"consistent with the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"bookmaker consensus."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The prediction market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" may be less informed"}
{"type":"thought","data":" than the local bookmaker"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market for obscure "}
{"type":"thought","data":"fixtures. The zero last"}

{"type":"thought","data":" no recent trades have"}
